# Gold tables and views

<!-- Generated by `make docs-tables` from the schemas in analytics/pipelines/src/pipelines/schemas/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Gold lives in the analytics PostgreSQL. Each relation below is a table in `gold_internal` with a view of the same name in `gold`, or a view in `gold` only. The public views leave out pipeline metadata such as `_commit_sequence` and `_is_deleted`; [the gold model](../../architecture/gold-model.md) describes what each view shows. **Type** is the PostgreSQL type, and **Nullable** `no` means `NOT NULL`.

## current_order_items

Latest version of every order item not deleted in the source; read by the business questions

Internal table `gold_internal.current_order_items`: Latest version of every order item, deleted ones included

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_item_id` | bigint | no | Order item identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `order_id` | bigint | yes | Order the item belongs to (orders.order_id) |
| `product_id` | bigint | yes | Product ordered (products.product_id) |
| `quantity` | integer | yes | Number of units ordered (source column quanity) |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_changed_at` | timestamp | no | Time the change was committed in the source database (Debezium source.ts_ms) |
| `_is_deleted` | boolean | no | Whether the row was deleted in the source; the version keeps its last known values |

## current_orders

Latest version of every order not deleted in the source

Internal table `gold_internal.current_orders`: Latest version of every order, deleted ones included

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | bigint | no | Order identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `status_key` | integer | no | Current order status (dim_order_status key) |
| `is_open` | boolean | no | Whether an order in this status is open; every status except COMPLETED is |
| `customer_id` | bigint | yes | Customer who placed the order (customers.customer_id) |
| `order_date` | date | yes | Date the order was placed |
| `delivery_date` | date | yes | Date the order is or was delivered |
| `order_date_key` | integer | yes | Order date as a dim_date key |
| `delivery_date_key` | integer | yes | Delivery date as a dim_date key |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_changed_at` | timestamp | no | Time the change was committed in the source database (Debezium source.ts_ms) |
| `_is_deleted` | boolean | no | Whether the row was deleted in the source; the version keeps its last known values |

## data_freshness

How up to date gold is: the newest source change time gold holds for each entity

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `entity` | varchar | no | Source entity: customers, products, orders or order_items |
| `last_changed_at` | timestamp | yes | Source commit time of the newest change of the entity stored in gold; null while the entity is empty |

## dim_customer

Customers, SCD2: one row per customer version, without folded repeats and deletes; a customer deleted in the source has no current version

Internal table `gold_internal.dim_customer`: Customers, SCD2: every customer version from silver, folded repeats and deletes included, only ever appended; dim_customer_versions derives which ones are folded, their validity and the current one; a customer deleted in the source has no current version

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `customer_key` | bigint | no | Surrogate key of the customer version |
| `customer_id` | bigint | no | Customer identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `customer_name` | varchar | yes | Name of the customer |
| `customer_address` | varchar | yes | Address of the customer |
| `is_active` | boolean | yes | Whether the customer is active |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_content_hash` | varchar | no | Hex SHA-256 of the content columns (key and audit columns excluded); unchanged content keeps its hash |
| `_is_deleted` | boolean | no | Whether the row was deleted in the source; the version keeps its last known values |
| `_valid_from` | timestamp | no | Time this version of the row became current: the change's commit time in the source |

## dim_customer_versions

Every customer version of gold_internal.dim_customer, with whether it is folded, its validity and whether it is current, computed from all versions of the customer in _commit_sequence order

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `customer_key` | bigint | no | Surrogate key of the customer version |
| `customer_id` | bigint | no | Customer identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `customer_name` | varchar | yes | Name of the customer |
| `customer_address` | varchar | yes | Address of the customer |
| `is_active` | boolean | yes | Whether the customer is active |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_content_hash` | varchar | no | Hex SHA-256 of the content columns (key and audit columns excluded); unchanged content keeps its hash |
| `_is_deleted` | boolean | no | Whether the row was deleted in the source; the version keeps its last known values |
| `_valid_from` | timestamp | no | Time this version of the row became current: the change's commit time in the source |
| `_is_folded` | boolean | no | Whether this version repeats the content and deletion state of the previous one by _commit_sequence, so it is not a version of its own and ends with the version it repeats |
| `_valid_to` | timestamp | yes | Time the next version of the row replaced this one; null while this version is current |
| `_is_current` | boolean | no | Whether this is the latest version of the row |

## dim_date

Calendar days from 2000-01-01 to 2099-12-31, one row per day

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `date_key` | integer | no | Day as an integer yyyymmdd |
| `calendar_date` | date | no | The calendar day |
| `year` | integer | no | Calendar year |
| `quarter` | integer | no | Calendar quarter, 1 to 4 |
| `month` | integer | no | Calendar month, 1 to 12 |
| `day_of_month` | integer | no | Day of the month, 1 to 31 |
| `day_of_week` | integer | no | ISO day of the week, 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday) |
| `is_weekend` | boolean | no | Whether the day is a Saturday or a Sunday |

## dim_order_status

Order statuses; a null or unexpected source status maps to UNKNOWN

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `status_key` | integer | no | Stable key of the status |
| `status_code` | varchar | no | Status as written in the source, or UNKNOWN |

## dim_product

Products, SCD2: one row per product version, without folded repeats and deletes; a product deleted in the source has no current version, and a new price is a new version

Internal table `gold_internal.dim_product`: Products, SCD2: every product version from silver, folded repeats and deletes included, only ever appended; dim_product_versions derives which ones are folded, their validity and the current one; a product deleted in the source has no current version, and a new price is a new version

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `product_key` | bigint | no | Surrogate key of the product version |
| `product_id` | bigint | no | Product identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `product_name` | varchar | yes | Name of the product |
| `barcode` | varchar | yes | Barcode of the product |
| `unit_price` | numeric | yes | Unit price of the product in this version (source unity_price), kept exact |
| `is_active` | boolean | yes | Whether the product is active |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_content_hash` | varchar | no | Hex SHA-256 of the content columns (key and audit columns excluded); unchanged content keeps its hash |
| `_is_deleted` | boolean | no | Whether the row was deleted in the source; the version keeps its last known values |
| `_valid_from` | timestamp | no | Time this version of the row became current: the change's commit time in the source |

## fact_order_history

Order history: one row per change to an order, without unchanged versions, with the range in which it was the latest version; a delete is the last row and is never current

Internal table `gold_internal.fact_order_history`: Order history: one row per change to an order from silver, unchanged versions and deletes included, partitioned by month of _changed_at

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | bigint | no | Order identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_changed_at` | timestamp | no | Time the change was committed in the source database (Debezium source.ts_ms) |
| `_change_op` | varchar | no | Kind of change: create, update, delete or snapshot (Debezium op c, u, d or r) |
| `status_key` | integer | no | Order status after the change (dim_order_status key) |
| `customer_id` | bigint | yes | Customer who placed the order (customers.customer_id) |
| `customer_key` | bigint | yes | Customer version valid at _changed_at, or the customer's first version for an earlier change (dim_customer key); null while the customer is not known yet, or once it is deleted |
| `order_date_key` | integer | yes | Order date as a dim_date key |
| `delivery_date_key` | integer | yes | Delivery date as a dim_date key |
| `_content_hash` | varchar | no | Hex SHA-256 of the content columns (key and audit columns excluded); unchanged content keeps its hash |
| `_is_deleted` | boolean | no | Whether the row was deleted in the source; the version keeps its last known values |

## fact_order_item_history

Order item history: one row per change to an order item, without unchanged versions, with the range in which it was the latest version; a delete is the last row and is never current

Internal table `gold_internal.fact_order_item_history`: Order item history: one row per change to an order item from silver, unchanged versions and deletes included, partitioned by month of _changed_at

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_item_id` | bigint | no | Order item identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `_commit_sequence` | bigint | no | Position of the change in the source's commit log (Debezium source.lsn); increases in commit order |
| `_changed_at` | timestamp | no | Time the change was committed in the source database (Debezium source.ts_ms) |
| `_change_op` | varchar | no | Kind of change: create, update, delete or snapshot (Debezium op c, u, d or r) |
| `order_id` | bigint | yes | Order the item belongs to (orders.order_id) |
| `product_id` | bigint | yes | Product ordered (products.product_id) |
| `product_key` | bigint | yes | Product version valid at _changed_at, or the product's first version for an earlier change (dim_product key); null while the product is not known yet, or once it is deleted |
| `quantity` | integer | yes | Number of units ordered (source column quanity) |
| `unit_price` | numeric | yes | Unit price of the product version valid at _changed_at, or of the product's first version for an earlier change: the price the order was placed at |
| `line_amount` | numeric | yes | quantity × unit_price |
| `_content_hash` | varchar | no | Hex SHA-256 of the content columns (key and audit columns excluded); unchanged content keeps its hash |
| `_is_deleted` | boolean | no | Whether the row was deleted in the source; the version keeps its last known values |

## open_orders

Current orders that are open: not deleted in the source and in a status whose is_open is true; read by the business questions

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `order_id` | bigint | no | Order identifier, the source table's primary key |
| `status_key` | integer | no | Current order status (dim_order_status key) |
| `customer_id` | bigint | yes | Customer who placed the order (customers.customer_id) |
| `order_date` | date | yes | Date the order was placed |
| `delivery_date` | date | yes | Date the order is or was delivered |
| `order_date_key` | integer | yes | Order date as a dim_date key |
| `delivery_date_key` | integer | yes | Delivery date as a dim_date key |
| `_changed_at` | timestamp | no | Time the change was committed in the source database (Debezium source.ts_ms) |

## open_orders_by_delivery_date_and_status

Number of open orders by delivery date and status: one row per delivery date and open status with at least one open order

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delivery_date` | date | yes | Date the order is or was delivered |
| `status_code` | varchar | no | Status as written in the source, or UNKNOWN |
| `open_orders` | bigint | no | Number of open orders with this delivery date and status |

## pending_items_by_product

Pending items by product: the order items, not deleted, of open orders

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `product_id` | bigint | yes | Product ordered (products.product_id) |
| `pending_items` | bigint | no | Number of pending items of the product |
| `pending_quantity` | bigint | yes | Total quantity of the product's pending items; null when none of them has a quantity |

## top_customers_by_pending_orders

The 3 customers with the most pending (open) orders, more when several share the third place; a customer not in dim_customer yet has a null name

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `customer_id` | bigint | yes | Customer who placed the order (customers.customer_id) |
| `customer_name` | varchar | yes | Name of the customer |
| `pending_orders` | bigint | no | Number of pending (open) orders of the customer |

## top_delivery_dates_by_open_orders

The 3 delivery dates with the most open orders, more when several share the third place

| Column | Type | Nullable | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `delivery_date` | date | yes | Date the order is or was delivered |
| `open_orders` | bigint | no | Number of open orders with this delivery date |
